backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining types and CRUD logic for listings, offers, messages, and user profiles with authorization and blob-storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of major frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables, dark mode styles, and global base styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint containing root div and script loader for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router configuring routes, layout, authentication gate, and page components.
Sign-in/out button using Internet Identity with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for first‑time users to submit their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Dashboard layout with sidebar navigation for listings, inbox, and offers.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer showing the current year and a Caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Implements the main header with navigation, auth controls, and a mobile menu for browsing, posting listings, and accessing the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/listings/ImageGa: Displays listing images in a carousel with navigation and a fallback placeholder image.
frontend/src/components/listings/ImageUp: Allows selecting, previewing, and uploading new listing images with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/listings/Listing: Shows a compact card view of a listing with image, title, location, type, and price.
Form for creating or editing a property listing with fields like title, type, category, price, and location.
frontend/src/components/messages/Contact: Modal dialog that lets authenticated users send a message to a listing's seller.
frontend/src/components/offers/MakeOffer: Modal dialog for authenticated users to choose an offer amount and submit an offer on a listing.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and maintains a backend actor tied to the current identity and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, loading, login, and identity state management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating listings, user profiles, and related backend data via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function to merge Tailwind class names.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/InboxMessag: Displays seller messages across listings with filtering, sorting, and mark‑responded actions.
frontend/src/pages/dashboard/MyListingsP: Displays the seller’s listings with loading, empty, and list states, and provides navigation to create, view, or edit listings.
Placeholder page showing that offer viewing is pending backend support.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Renders the property feed with search, filters, and listing cards using data from useFetchRandomListings.
frontend/src/pages/listings/EditListingP: Fetches a listing, checks ownership, and provides a tabbed interface to edit listing details and images.
frontend/src/pages/listings/ListingDetai: Shows detailed property info with images, metadata, and options to contact the seller, make offers, or edit if owner.
frontend/src/pages/listings/NewListingPa: Form page for creating a new listing and redirects to its edit page after creation.
frontend/src/utils/format.ts: Utility functions for formatting amounts as INR and converting timestamps to readable dates.
frontend/src/utils/offers.ts: Generates offer pricing options based on a listing’s quoted price and formats INR values.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across browser and hash routing.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending colors, layout, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing versions, required images, and a list of implemented features for a real estate marketplace including auth, listings, images, browsing, messaging, and offer flows.
